title: An atomic certificate for triangular-lattice universal optimality

abstractEnglish: We prove that the density-one triangular lattice minimizes the lower energy per particle for every nonnegative completely monotone function of squared distance, among all locally finite planar configurations of centered disk density one. The comparison includes infinite energies. The proof constructs sharp Gaussian Fourier minorants using an atomic interpolation certificate.
